title: One-disk Tower of Hanoi (f(1))
summary: Move the sole disk on rod A directly to destination rod C in a single move.
context: The three rods from left to right are A, B, and C. Only one top disk may be moved at a time, and a larger disk may never sit on a smaller one. Subproblem f(1) moves a single disk and serves as the base case of the recursive decomposition.
description: A green rounded rectangle represents the sole disk. The two frames show the state before and after that single move.

frames.title: Sole disk on rod A
frames.explanation: Initially A = [green disk], B = [], and C = [], with no move made yet. Because nothing blocks the disk and destination rod C is empty, it can move directly from A to C without using auxiliary rod B.
frames.key_state: Rod A holds one disk, rods B and C are empty, and no move has occurred yet.
frames.announcement: Show the initial state with the single disk on rod A.

frames.title: Move the disk directly from rod A to rod C
frames.explanation: Because the sole green disk at the top of A is unobstructed and destination rod C is empty, move the disk directly from A to C without using B. Now A = [], B = [], and C = [green disk]; one single-disk move is complete, finishing the task.
frames.key_state: One single-disk move completed; the disk is on rod C, and rods A and B are empty.
frames.announcement: Move the sole disk directly from rod A to rod C.
